calls.reason: CoreWeave's disclosure establishes the original 9.25% coupon, while the preceding week's 11.12% yield offers only partial support. The packet does not establish the September 29 range or its 13.22% endpoint.

CoreWeave's financing announcement describes a new five-year facility, not repayment outcomes. The packet provides no evidence that most referenced deals will ultimately leave creditors unpaid; Zitron also frames this as a belief.

JLL reports an 18-month average for 50 MW facilities, while Epoch gives AI campus timelines of 1–3.6 years, including projections. These mixed scopes and milestones do not clearly establish or refute the general claim.
NVIDIA acknowledges infrastructure constraints and reports full utilization of operating cloud capacity. Neither disclosure establishes how much of its outstanding GPU orders comes from stockpiling.

Google documents operational Ironwood TPU use at Citadel Securities, but supplies no purchase dates or representative deployment delays. The packet cannot establish whether half of chip sales precede use by years.

PYMNTS reports enterprise customer concentration, not an 80% startup share of total revenue; YipitData warns against that extrapolation. The packet also establishes neither widespread startup failure nor resulting lab revenue declines.
